base.description: open onto that pushed branch instead of main: the layer below in a stack, linked after with x lane stack link

verbs.name: lane stack link
verbs.purpose: link this branch's layers (<branch>, -2, -3 on origin) into a github stack, bottom-up; hidden while stacks are on trial
touches: github — a stack of the layers' prs, as the x-coder-cc app

verbs.name: lane stack view
verbs.purpose: print the github stack this branch's pr sits in, bottom-up, with each pr and state; hidden while stacks are on trial
touches: github — the stacks api and the open prs, read as the x-coder-cc app
